engine: MetaTrader4 compatibility; Ostium costs repriced externally
mechanism: Trade a short RSI pullback only in the direction of a moving-average state; use market entry, ATR-scaled protection and a bounded bar exit.
falsifier: No artifact contains both MA and RSI semantics and survives development plus current Ostium base costs.
discard_criteria: attempt budget cannot be observed and controlled
artifact lacks either MA or RSI semantics
artifact changes to a non-market entry or fixed-distance risk
non-positive expectancy after current base costs
validation or sealed holdout is accessed during Builder
